vllm.implication: Full validation now, recorded gap is platform-local: Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration and Qwen3_5MTP are registered with maintained implementations at vLLM main 4d2a68d and transformers support ships in every release tag since v5.8.0, but vLLM-on-ROCm-gfx1151 runtime is unvalidated for qwen3_5 (community source builds only; head_dim 256 forces the Triton attention backend because the custom paged-attention gate requires head_size 128), and no open ROCm-specific qwen3_5 MTP issue exists to track (vllm#52480/#52481 are platform-agnostic; TP=1 on one iGPU should dodge #52480).

gguf.implication: Full validation now: llama.cpp master 3cb7ffb registers arch qwen35 with GDN linear attention, single-block MTP draft head (load + graph + LLAMA_CONTEXT_TYPE_MTP + draft-mtp driver) and Qwen3-VL-type mmproj vision, prebuilt GGUFs from unsloth/lmstudio-community/bartowski cover every size class, and AMD's official gfx1151 route is llama.cpp/Vulkan with MTP=4; recorded gaps: a HIP build for gfx1151 is possible (-DGPU_TARGETS=gfx1151, RDNA3_5-aware, merged MMQ tuning) but not CI-covered with an open Strix Halo prefill-perf issue, and self-conversion carries open bug #27019 / unmerged fix PR #27132 in the exact GDN V-head-reorder code path the 27B exercises, so prebuilts are primary and the converter is fallback.

kv_cache_fp8.evidence: docs/results/spike/quant-kv.md: vLLM supports fp8 KV cache on ROCm as e4m3 only (e5m2 is CUDA-only) but the combination is unvalidated on gfx1151, where the model's head_dim 256 makes use_rocm_custom_paged_attention False so KV dtype routes through the Triton attention backend with no in-tree guard (watch the #13147-class fp8+prefix-caching interaction); llama.cpp makes q8_0 KV a first-class lever (-ctk/-ctv, flash-attn mandatory for quantized V, head_dim 256 divides all block sizes) while an f8 cache type does not exist upstream.
